notes.title: English Version Released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36817056/07013613884c8489e047205e8d4e3d4a76fd5b23.png[/img]
Nyahallo fellow kemonomimi fans around the world~ 

Good news, you're getting an early Christmas present today! Amairo Chocolate is officially out in English on Steam! No need to buy the game again, but if you haven't already bought it because you were waiting now is your chance! If you own the game already just download the update and start playing. You can freely change the font to whatever you'd like as well as choose the language you'd like to play in when you start the game. Enjoy Amairo and thank you for all the fans who waited patiently for the release!

notes.title: Amairo Chocolate English Version in Beta!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you're doing well! We have some exciting news to share with our English fans: Amairo Chocolate English version has entered beta testing! We have some screenshots we'd like to share as well. Please note that the text displayed may be changed and does not represent the final product. We hope you're excited as we are to start playing!

notes.title: English release is coming
notes.notes:
We're here to let you know that we've started working on the English release of Amairo Chocolate! It's currently 30% translated into English at this time. While it may be a while before the English version is ready, you can pick up the release in anticipation for the English version. The English version is planned to be a free update to this release. Please keep an eye on our websites for more information on the status as it changes over time!
